name: Arabian Jasmine
hook: Mogra dying over winter? It can't take any frost.

steps.title: Bright, no hot sun
steps.tip: Give it your brightest spot, even some direct sun, but shade it from hot afternoon sun.

steps.title: Moist, drier in winter
steps.tip: Keep the soil moist but well drained while it grows. Water only a little in winter.

steps.title: Frost-free all winter
steps.tip: It handles cool nights but not freezing. Keep it indoors or in a greenhouse all winter.

steps.title: Feed monthly, low nitrogen
steps.tip: While it is growing, feed it once a month with a low-nitrogen fertilizer.

steps.title: Watch for mites indoors
steps.tip: Check often for aphids, scale, mealybugs and spider mites, which attack plants kept indoors.

steps.title: Root summer cuttings
steps.tip: In summer, root cuttings of firm new shoots. In autumn, you can also pin a low stem into a nearby pot to root.

outro: Bright light, no frost, monthly feeding: mogra in scented bloom.

sources.title: Florida Museum of Natural History: Arabian Jasmine
